critical_code_review_comments: server.py:4132 — GET /accounts/summary is defined AFTER PUT/DELETE /accounts/{entry_id} in the same router. Since there's no GET /accounts/{entry_id} route this works, but for clarity consider moving /summary before the parameterized routes to avoid any future path-param confusion.

server.py:4193 _serialise_reading — derives 'overdue' on read, doesn't persist. This is correct for display but PUT update responses also re-derive; if a row's status is persisted as 'active' with end_date in the past, GET returns 'overdue' but the DB still says 'active'. Summary counters correctly use derived status. Acceptable — just be aware that filtering by DB status vs derived status can differ; current implementation filters AFTER derivation, which is correct.

server.py:4120 DELETE /accounts — delete restriction is 'admin or manager', while the review_request wording mentions 'admin'. Current more permissive behavior is fine (manager can delete) but worth confirming with product.

Tests: /app/backend/tests fixtures assumed Bearer token auth; real app uses HttpOnly cookies. Future tests should use requests.Session() with cookie persistence (fix already applied in iteration23 test file).

PwaInstaller + service-worker.js — SW correctly skips /api/* (per main agent context). Not verified offline-behavior end-to-end in this run; consider an E2E test that asserts fetch('/api/projects') rejects after setOffline(true).
